routes.label: untimely_schema@https://tapvizier.cds.unistra.fr/TAPVizieR/tap
routes.query: SELECT table_name, description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.tables WHERE LOWER(description) LIKE '%untimely%' OR LOWER(description) LIKE '%un-timely%' OR LOWER(description) LIKE '%unwise variab%' OR LOWER(description) LIKE '%mid-infrared variable%' OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%untimely%' OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%un-timely%'
